$comment: Named tokens the approved design (klinfits-handoff/design/drop01-page.dc.html) uses on top of klinfits-handoff/design/tokens.json. Merged by scripts/build-tokens.mjs. An entry that replaces a handoff token must say "override": true. "fluid": [min, max] in px becomes a rem + vw clamp that grows across "fluidViewports", chosen so each size equals the design at 390px and 1280px wide.

type.name: display-hero
type.usage: The hero headline. Design: 56px on phones to 112px (the handoff token said 120).

type.usage: Sizes and order headings. Design: 44px to 72px.
